entry.name: pictslider
entry.description: A slider control that uses pictures in external files for its appearance. It uses two pictures--one for the "knob" and one for the background over which the knob moves. The pictslider object has default pictures that are used if you do not want to supply pictures of your own, but its intended use is creating controls with customized appearances.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Toggles mouse control of theobject. The default is 1 (enabled). If a separate set of inactive images is present in the pictslider object's graphics file and if the inactive images attribute is set, the active message will also change the appearance of the control.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color of theobject in RGBA format.

attributes.name: bkgnddrag
attributes.description: Toggles background drag mode for theobject. When this mode is enabled, clicking and dragging anywhere in the background area of the slider will move the knob; the knob will move relative to the motion of the mouse, just as if you had clicked in the knob itself. The messagedisables this mode. You must also uncheck the KnobJumps to Click Location checkbox in theobject's Inspector or send the object amessage to enable this mode.

attributes.name: bkgndpict
attributes.description: Designates the graphics file that theobject will use for the control's background image. The symbol used as a filename must either be the name of a file in Max's current search path, or an absolute pathname for the file (e.g. "").

attributes.name: bkgndsize
attributes.description: Sets theobject to change the size of the object to match the size of the background picture. After receiving this message, the object's size cannot be changed.allows the control to be resized in the usual manner by dragging its lower-right corner.

attributes.name: bottommargin
attributes.description: Sets the bottom margin, in pixels, for the. The margin reduces the area in which the knob moves; if a margin is zero, the knob can move all the way to the bottom of the slider.

attributes.name: bottomvalue
attributes.description: Sets the values emitted by theobject when the knob is moved as far as possible to the bottom. The messagewill cause the control to send 100 out of its left outlet when the knob is moved all the way to the bottom.

attributes.name: clickedimage
attributes.description: Specifies that the graphics file used by theobject contains an additional image to be displayed when the control is clicked.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Sets the knob color of theobject in RGBA format.

attributes.name: elementcolor
attributes.description: Sets the knob color of theobject when it is dragged in RGBA format.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: horizontaltracking
attributes.description: Sets the horizontal tracking ratio for movements of theobject's knob. The default value is 1.0. Values greater than one cause the knob to move more quickly when dragged; values less than one cause it to move more slowly.

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: imagemask
attributes.description: When set to 1, specifies that the graphics file used by theobject contains image masks. This attribute is present for legacy support - it has been superseded by the use of alpha channels in images.

attributes.name: inactiveimage
attributes.description: When set to non-zero, specifies that the graphics file used by theobject contains additional images for the object's inactive state.

attributes.name: invisiblebkgnd
attributes.description: When set to non-zero, theobject will not draw any background image. The knob will appear to float above any objects underneath it.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: jump
attributes.description: When set to non-zero, makesmove the knob to the position of the cursor if you click in the object outside of the knob.disables this behavior; you must click in the knob itself to move it.

attributes.name: knobpict
attributes.description: Designates the graphics file that theobject will use for the control's knob image. By convention, theobject uses images saved in Portable Network Graphics (.png) format. If you are using Max on Windows and want to to work with images other than PNG or PICT files, we recommend that you install QuickTime and choose a complete install of all optional components. The symbol used as a filename must either be the name of a file in Max's current search path, or an absolute pathname for the file (e.g. "").

attributes.name: leftmargin
attributes.description: Sets the left margin, in pixels, for the. The margin reduces the area in which the knob moves; if a margin is zero, the knob can move all the way to the left of the slider.

attributes.name: leftvalue
attributes.description: Sets the values emitted by theobject when the knob is moved as far as possible to the left. The messagewill cause the control to send 100 out of its left outlet when the knob is moved all the way to the left.

attributes.name: movehorizontal
attributes.description: When set to non-zero, allows the knob to change when the mouse is moved horizontally. The messageprevents the knob from moving when the mouse is moved horizontally.

attributes.name: movevertical
attributes.description: When set to non-zero, allows the knob to change when the mouse is moved vertically. The messageprevents the knob from moving when the mouse is moved vertically.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

attributes.name: parameter_enable
attributes.description: Enables use of this object withandin Max.

attributes.name: parameter_mappable
attributes.description: When parameter_mappable is enabled, the object will be available for mapping to keyboard or MIDI input using the. (default = 1).

attributes.name: rightvalue
attributes.description: Sets the values emitted by theobject when the knob is moved as far as possible to the right. The messagewill cause the control to send 100 out of its left outlet when the knob is moved all the way to the right.

attributes.name: topvalue
attributes.description: Sets the values emitted by theobject when the knob is moved as far as possible to the top. The messagewill cause the control to send 100 out of its left outlet when the knob is moved all the way to the top.

attributes.description: Sets the vertical tracking ratio for movements of theobject's knob. The default value is 1.0. Values greater than one cause the knob to move more quickly when dragged; values less than one cause it to move more slowly.

messages.name: (drag)
messages.description: When a image file is dragged from the Max File Browser to aobject, the image will be loaded as the object's background image.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking on theobject and dragging sends the current value out the outlet. Additional behaviors depend on how the object is configured using messages or setting attributes.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Sends the current values of theto its outlets. The horizontal value is sent out the left outlet; the vertical value out its right outlet.

messages.name: bkgndpicture
messages.digest: Load an image file for background appearance
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol that specifies a filename, designates the graphics file that theobject will use for the control's background image. By convention, theobject uses images saved in Portable Network Graphics (.png) format. If you are using Max on Windows and want to to work with images other than PNG or PICT files, we recommend that you install QuickTime and choose a complete install of all optional components. The symbol used as a filename must either be the name of a file in Max's current search path, or an absolute pathname for the file (e.g. "").

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: sets theobject's horizontal value. The value is also sent out the left outlet, and theobject's current vertical value is sent out the right outlet.In right inlet: sets theobject's vertical value. The value is also sent out the right outlet, and the control's current horizontal value is sent out the left outlet.

messages.name: knobpicture
messages.digest: Load an image file for knob appearance
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a symbol that specifies a filename, designates the graphics file that theobject will use for the control's knob file. The symbol used as a filename must either be the name of a file in Max's current search path, or an absolute pathname for the file (e.g. ""). The wordby itself puts up a standard Open Document dialog box.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: A list of two numbers sent to the left inlet sets theobject's horizontal value to the first number and its vertical value to the second. The two values are sent out the left and right outlets.

messages.name: readanybkgnd
messages.digest: Load any file for background appearance
messages.description: The wordfollowed by the name of a file will read any type of file into theobject and attempt to interpret it as a background image.

messages.name: readanyknob
messages.digest: Load any file for knob appearance
messages.description: The wordfollowed by the name of a file will read any type of file into theobject and attempt to interpret it as a knob image.

messages.name: set
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets the pictcslider object's horizontal value but does not send the value out its left outlet.The word, followed by two numbers, sets theobject's horizontal value to the first number and its vertical value to the to the second number, but does not send the values out its outlets.In right inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets theobject's vertical value, but does not send the value out its right outlet.

messages.name: track
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a float, sets the tracking ratio for horizontal movements of theobject's knob.In right inlet: The word, followed by a float, sets the tracking ratio for vertical movements of theobject's knob.
